note: hubconf.py is a PyTorch Hub configuration file that re-exports DINOv3 model factory functions. It contains no directly callable code — only imports and a dependencies list. Use torch.hub.load() to access the exported models.
load_backbone_models: load DINOv3 backbone models like vitb16 or convnext_base via torch hub
load_classifier_model: load the DINOv3 vit7b16 linear classifier via torch hub
load_depth_estimation_model: load DINOv3 depth estimation models like vit7b16_dd via torch hub
load_object_detection_model: load the DINOv3 vit7b16 object detection model via torch hub
load_segmentation_model: load the DINOv3 vit7b16 mask segmentation model via torch hub
